missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Разговор' is the nominative subject of the past-tense 'был'. 'Важный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'очень' intensifies the importance.

missions.phrase: Я не хочу продолжать этот разговор.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object, inanimate. 'Разговор' is the accusative direct object of 'продолжать', identical to the nominative because the noun is inanimate. 'Этот' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after после. The preposition 'после' governs the genitive, so 'разговора' is genitive. 'Долгого' agrees in the masculine genitive. A natural time-sequence pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative object. The set phrase 'придать значения' takes a dative for what is undervalued, so 'разговору' is dative. A useful idiom for dismissing something.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after adjective. The adjective 'доволен' governs the instrumental, so 'разговором' is the instrumental object of satisfaction. 'Нашим' agrees in the same case.

missions.phrase: В нашем разговоре была одна проблема.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В разговоре' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to mark the setting. 'Нашем' agrees in the masculine prepositional, and 'проблема' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Разговоры' is the nominative plural subject. 'Наши' agrees in the plural, and 'интересные' is the predicate adjective. A model for the plural form.

missions.phrase: У нас было много серьёзных разговоров.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after много. 'Разговоров' is the genitive plural after the quantity word 'много'. 'Серьёзных' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'было' is neuter with the quantity.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural after от. The preposition 'от' governs the genitive, so 'разговоров' is the genitive plural. 'Этих' agrees in the genitive plural. A pattern for being tired of something.
Strategic focus: Dative plural after к. The preposition 'к' governs the dative, so 'разговорам' is the dative plural. 'Старым' agrees in the dative plural. A model for returning to a topic.
